related.title: 超高真空腔體建置
related.transfer: 可遷移「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」與「真空計校正與不確定度鏈」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超高真空腔體建置的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" and "Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦葉片動量傳遞、壓縮比與前級、轉子工程，以及從 1000 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar 的量測鏈；超高真空腔體建置則以出氣率、傳導率、金屬密封、烘烤與壓力量測構成的 10⁻¹¹ mbar 腔體工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on blade momentum transfer, compression and backing, rotor engineering, and the measurement chain from 1000 to 10⁻¹¹ mbar; Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction centres on outgassing, conductance, metal seals, bakeout and pressure measurement that make a 10⁻¹¹ mbar chamber, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉子葉片與氣體分子」與「腔壁的氣體來源」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超高真空腔體建置，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「超高真空壓力量測與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Rotor blades and gas molecules” and “Gas sources at the chamber wall”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ultrahigh-vacuum chamber construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ultrahigh-vacuum pressure measurement and its error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

以「計數統計、死時間與動態範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計
history.text: 1906 年 Pirani 提出熱傳導真空計，1913 年 Gaede 做出分子拖曳泵，1923 年 Holweck 加上螺旋槽結構；1937 年 Penning 發明冷陰極游離計，1950 年 Bayard 與 Alpert 的細絲收集極把量測下限推到 10⁻⁸ Torr 以下。1958 年 Becker 在 Arthur Pfeiffer 公司發明軸向葉片的渦輪分子泵，之後陶瓷球混合軸承與主動磁浮軸承相繼普及，混合 Holweck 段讓隔膜泵也能做前級。今天渦輪泵與真空計的組合是分析儀器、半導體製程、加速器與研究腔體的標準抽氣與量測方案。
history.textEn: Pirani proposed the thermal-conductivity gauge in 1906, Gaede built the molecular drag pump in 1913 and Holweck added the spiral-groove geometry in 1923; Penning invented the cold-cathode ionisation gauge in 1937, and in 1950 the thin-wire collector of Bayard and Alpert pushed the measurement floor below 10⁻⁸ Torr. In 1958 Becker at Arthur Pfeiffer invented the axial-bladed turbomolecular pump, ceramic-ball hybrid bearings and active magnetic levitation followed, and hybrid Holweck stages allowed diaphragm pumps to serve as backing. Today the combination of turbopumps and gauges is the standard pumping and measurement solution for analytical instruments, semiconductor processing, accelerators and research chambers.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「分子流下的葉片動量傳遞」到「驗收、維護週期與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow" through "Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
